checks.name: Compatibility reads configured environment without creating or disclosing stored secrets
Strict inputs reject provider/URL injection, bad revision, unknown schema and malformed key
Saving new key writes authenticated ciphertext, CAS revision and no plaintext
Restarted state/service decrypts the committed key and default
Stale save cannot overwrite key or default and makes no provider request
Provider authentication rejection preserves the previous credential and revision
Unavailable secure storage rejects new keys without plaintext fallback
Fresh empty conversation model selection persists independently of default
Default change affects new conversations and preserves an existing native binding
History-only and archived conversations cannot masquerade as empty selections
Transport failure projects a safe error with last official cache and no raw exception
Successful official removal replaces cache and forbids removed model default
Oversized/malformed official responses cannot replace last valid catalogue
Concurrent state CAS permits one committed revision
Unknown schema fails closed; unreadable ciphertext permits explicit replacement without credential fallback
Typed API rejects extra fields and sanitizes unknown failures
All new channels reject non-main-frame sender before host execution
Busy state is visible without leaking private session binding

boundaries: Disposable real SQLite and bounded simulated provider responses; Windows safeStorage and live provider/UI are separate gates.
